## Problem

The frontend should display data drawn from the curated, validated JSON fixture set in
`C:/Users/DTA_WorkStation/Downloads/json_fixture/` rather than the current overly-comprehensive,
"nonsense" seed generated by `packages/mock-data/src/seed-extended.ts`.

The curated set is validated (0 cross-reference errors) and matches the real CSPH GPL domain —
Cameroon LPG traceability: SCDP depots, 8 marketers, transporters, livreurs; subsidies (Order
0327/2018, 1,524 FCFA/bottle, 6,500 FCFA retail); anomaly categories (siphonnage, substitution,
falsification, diversion); state-machine status values.

Files: 01_organizations.json, 02_users_and_roles.json, 03_sites_and_client_sites.json,
04_vehicles_and_drivers.json, 05_devices.json, 06_delivery_tours.json, 07_compliance.json,
08_anomalies.json, 09_notifications.json (see 00_INDEX.md for schema + counts).

Replace placeholder/nonsense image + PDF URLs in fixtures with https://placehold.net/default.png.

## Solution

Work FRONTEND-ONLY, page by page, consuming the curated JSON fixtures as the mock-data source.
Retire `seed-extended.ts` from active use. For each frontend page, inspect the relevant fixture
JSON and design the proper interface to display that data before implementing. Discuss the
interface at page level before building.
